\section{The Heptagonal Ring \texorpdfstring{$\mathbb{Z}_7$}{Z7}}
\label{sec:ring-z7}

The cyclic ring $\mathbb{Z}_{7}$ admits $\mathbf{18}$ dihedral orbits (16 \textcolor{mosaicblue}{\textbf{achiral}}, 2 \textcolor{mosaicpink}{\textbf{chiral}}).\\

\section{The Octagonal Ring \texorpdfstring{$\mathbb{Z}_8$}{Z8}}
\label{sec:ring-z8}

The cyclic ring $\mathbb{Z}_{8}$ admits $\mathbf{30}$ dihedral orbits (24 \textcolor{mosaicblue}{\textbf{achiral}}, 6 \textcolor{mosaicpink}{\textbf{chiral}}).\\

\section{The Enneagonal Ring \texorpdfstring{$\mathbb{Z}_9$}{Z9}}
\label{sec:ring-z9}

The cyclic ring $\mathbb{Z}_{9}$ admits $\mathbf{46}$ dihedral orbits (32 \textcolor{mosaicblue}{\textbf{achiral}}, 14 \textcolor{mosaicpink}{\textbf{chiral}}).\\

\section{The Decagonal Ring \texorpdfstring{$\mathbb{Z}_{10}$}{Z10}}
\label{sec:ring-z10}

The cyclic ring $\mathbb{Z}_{10}$ admits $\mathbf{78}$ dihedral orbits (48 \textcolor{mosaicblue}{\textbf{achiral}}, 30 \textcolor{mosaicpink}{\textbf{chiral}}).\\

\section{The Hendecagonal Ring \texorpdfstring{$\mathbb{Z}_{11}$}{Z11}}
\label{sec:ring-z11}

The cyclic ring $\mathbb{Z}_{11}$ admits $\mathbf{126}$ dihedral orbits (64 \textcolor{mosaicblue}{\textbf{achiral}}, 62 \textcolor{mosaicpink}{\textbf{chiral}}).\\

\section{The Dodecagonal Ring \texorpdfstring{$\mathbb{Z}_{12}$}{Z12}}
\label{sec:ring-z12}

The cyclic ring $\mathbb{Z}_{12}$ admits $\mathbf{224}$ dihedral orbits (96 \textcolor{mosaicblue}{\textbf{achiral}}, 128 \textcolor{mosaicpink}{\textbf{chiral}}).\\

\section{The Tridecagonal Ring \texorpdfstring{$\mathbb{Z}_{13}$}{Z13}}
\label{sec:ring-z13}

The cyclic ring $\mathbb{Z}_{13}$ admits $\mathbf{380}$ dihedral orbits (128 \textcolor{mosaicblue}{\textbf{achiral}}, 252 \textcolor{mosaicpink}{\textbf{chiral}}).\\

\section{The Tetradecagonal Ring \texorpdfstring{$\mathbb{Z}_{14}$}{Z14}}
\label{sec:ring-z14}

The cyclic ring $\mathbb{Z}_{14}$ admits $\mathbf{687}$ dihedral orbits (192 \textcolor{mosaicblue}{\textbf{achiral}}, 495 \textcolor{mosaicpink}{\textbf{chiral}}).\\

\section{The Pentadecagonal Ring \texorpdfstring{$\mathbb{Z}_{15}$}{Z15}}
\label{sec:ring-z15}

The cyclic ring $\mathbb{Z}_{15}$ admits $\mathbf{1224}$ dihedral orbits (256 \textcolor{mosaicblue}{\textbf{achiral}}, 968 \textcolor{mosaicpink}{\textbf{chiral}}).\\

\section{The Hexadecagonal Ring \texorpdfstring{$\mathbb{Z}_{16}$}{Z16}}
\label{sec:ring-z16}

The cyclic ring $\mathbb{Z}_{16}$ admits $\mathbf{2250}$ dihedral orbits (384 \textcolor{mosaicblue}{\textbf{achiral}}, 1866 \textcolor{mosaicpink}{\textbf{chiral}}).\\
